verbatim: 登记状态：索引候选记录，需核对官方现行版本。官方核对入口：国家药品监督管理局药品查询平台 https://www.nmpa.gov.cn/
whyItIsWrong: A reference entry that tells the reader how to verify instead of naming what was read: the label came from the EviMed label index, and the link is the regulator's home page, which no tool of the run retrieved.
note: Caught only by the control plane after the run (specialist_cited_source_unrecorded), so the run never saw it. Since 2026-09-28 the run's own gate raises it at submission, with the line and the ways out, and the snapshot carries the platform's retrieval record. A fix has to cite the label by its approval number and label id.
